item.title: Bad Bunny Turned Super Bowl Halftime Into A Joyous Tribute To Puerto Rico
item.description: In between the Seattle Seahawks facing off the New England Patriots, Bad Bunny played the Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show. The Puerto Rican musician is the first Latino and Spanish-speaking artist to perform as a solo act during the big game, which this year is going down at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California and airing on NBC.
